messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- [2025-10-13] handover/2025-10-13-ledger: From today the pager for the ledger rings Cinder, not team Atlas. Ownership transferred.
- [2025-01-08] standup/atlas/2025-01-08: For the record, the ledger service is owned by the Atlas team.
- [2025-06-27] handover/2025-06-27-notifier-correction: Correction to the handover note of 2025-06-11: the notification service went to the Dune team, not team Cinder. The Cinder team never owned it; the note was written against the wrong team.
- [2025-01-17] standup/cinder/2025-01-17: Team Cinder owns the product catalog.
- [2025-01-17] standup/cinder/2025-01-17-2: For the record, the indexer is owned by Cinder.
- [2025-11-27] standup/cinder/2025-11-27: As of today Diego Alvarez is on the Ember team; Cinder loses a pair of hands. Yuki takes the Cinder pager from Diego, who is leaving the team.
- [2025-10-16] standup/cinder/2025-10-16: The Cinder team has moved to the third floor.
- [2025-03-20] handover/2025-03-20-image-resizer: Ownership change: the image resizer now sits with team Ember. Team Dune no longer owns it.
- [2025-09-23] handover/2025-09-23-scheduler: From today the pager for the job scheduler rings the Cinder team, not team Dune. Ownership transferred.
- [2025-05-20] handover/2025-05-20-search-indexer: Team Atlas is taking over search-indexer from team Cinder, effective today. Dashboards and alerts are being repointed.
- [2025-04-24] standup/cinder/2025-04-24: Rotation day for the Cinder team: Yuki hands the pager to Diego.
- [2025-01-09] standup/boreal/2025-01-09-2: The Boreal team owns the notifier.
- [2026-03-11] standup/cinder/2026-03-11: No deploys to Ledger from 2026-03-30 to 2026-04-03 because of the fiscal year close.
- [2025-07-17] standup/atlas/2025-07-17: The ledger remains a Atlas service.
- [2026-03-11] standup/cinder/2026-03-11-2: The Cinder team noticed that billing-api's cold start time tripled after the runtime upgrade and pinged the owners.
- [2025-12-19] handover/2025-12-19-catalog: Atlas is taking over the product catalog from the Cinder team, effective today. Dashboards and alerts are being repointed.
- [2025-09-23] standup/dune/2025-09-23: Reporting switches from Ledger to the bus as its source. Why: the nightly ledger scans were blocking billing runs. Reporting no longer depends on Ledger.
- [2025-08-15] standup/boreal/2025-08-15-2: Team Boreal still owns the bus, in case anyone asks.
- [2026-03-09] handover/2026-03-09-feature-flags-correction: Correction to the handover note of 2026-02-11: the flags service went to team Atlas, not Dune. Dune never owned it; the note was written against the wrong team.
- [2025-06-11] handover/2025-06-11-notifier: The notification service has a new home: Cinder. Boreal kept it until today.
- [2025-09-16] handover/2025-09-16-auth-gateway: The Ember team handed the authentication gateway to Cinder today; Oskar Lind wrote up the handover doc for Diego.
- [2025-07-17] standup/cinder/2025-07-17: Rotation day for the Cinder team: Yuki Tanaka hands the pager to Diego Alvarez.
- [2025-09-03] standup/cinder/2025-09-03-2: Heads-up from the Cinder team: the auth gateway's cold start time tripled after the runtime upgrade.
- [2026-04-16] standup/atlas/2026-04-16: The Atlas team saw that the ledger service's disk usage jumped 30 percent following the retention change; not their service, so they flagged it.
- [2025-05-14] standup/cinder/2025-05-14: Observation from the Cinder team: after the cache change, webhooks' memory use grew steadily for a week.
- [2025-01-09] standup/boreal/2025-01-09-3: For the record, the webhook dispatcher is owned by team Boreal.
- [2025-09-05] standup/cinder/2025-09-05: Reminder from the Cinder team: page Yuki for anything this cycle, not Diego.
- [2025-01-20] standup/ember/2025-01-20: The job scheduler lives with the Ember team. For the record, the authentication gateway is owned by Ember.
- [2025-09-05] standup/dune/2025-09-05: The Dune team still owns the scheduler, in case anyone asks.
- [2025-01-08] standup/cinder/2025-01-08: For the org chart: Yuki Tanaka and Diego are on Cinder.
- [2025-10-24] standup/cinder/2025-10-24: Diego has the Cinder pager this cycle, taking over from Yuki.
- [2026-04-13] standup/ember/2026-04-13-2: Ember still owns the reporting service, in case anyone asks.
- [2025-04-24] standup/cinder/2025-04-24-2: Heads-up from the Cinder team: feature-flags' p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy.
- [2025-02-27] standup/cinder/2025-02-27: Yuki has the Cinder pager this cycle, taking over from Diego.
- [2026-04-03] standup/cinder/2026-04-03: Cinder runs its planning on Mondays.
- [2025-02-21] standup/boreal/2025-02-21-2: Boreal noticed that the ledger service's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change and pinged the owners.

Question: Which team owned the ledger before Cinder took it over?

message.reasoning:
The memory entries about the ledger:
- [2025-01-08] standup/atlas: ledger service owned by Atlas team.
- [2025-10-13] handover: from today pager for ledger rings Cinder, not team Atlas. Ownership transferred.
- [2025-07-17] standup/atlas: ledger remains an Atlas service.

So before Cinder took it over (2025-10-13), the ledger was owned by Atlas.
